objective: Batch project workbench owner and statistics queries while preserving response and authorization behavior.

requirements.statement: N projects use one owner query and one statistics query after the main project query
Existing workbench fields and empty-list behavior remain equivalent
acceptance: empty list has no batch query
counterexample: missing field or extra empty-list query

requirements.statement: Tenant and project visibility conditions remain enforced

assumptions.text: correlated aggregate subqueries preserve per-project counts
assumptions.basis: each subquery is correlated by tenant and project id

unknowns.question: whether local data has null owner ids

decisions.decision: batch only workbench path; retain detail decorator
